nodes.name: Build rank rows
nodes.notes: Pure transform. Finds our owned domain's position in each SERP; folds in search volume; scores priority (striking distance 4-15 x volume). previous_position is set by the DB trigger trg_maya_sd_shift_position on upsert, not here.

nodes.name: Upsert striking distance
nodes.notes: One array upsert on (product, query). merge-duplicates only touches the columns in the payload, so a later GSC sweep can own clicks/impressions/ctr on the same row without clobbering.
